decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand and put pressure on the board early. By combining creatures with haste and powerful disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and finish the game before they have a chance to recover. The inclusion of Feign Death and Undying Malice allows for extra value and resilience, making it a formidable force in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on casting cheap cascade spells like Violent Outburst to quickly put pressure on the opponent by bringing powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent onto the battlefield. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Dead / Gone and Subtlety provide additional removal and disruption options. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, explosive plays while maintaining control of the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply pressure. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to maintain control of the board. Additionally, cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect key creatures and generate value. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast, efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize cascade and aggro strategies to overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to cast spells with cascade, such as Violent Outburst and Ardent Plea, which allows the player to cast a spell from the top of the deck without paying its mana cost. This triggers the cascade ability again, potentially chaining multiple spells for overwhelming board presence. The deck also includes cards like Crashing Footfalls and Shardless Agent to generate additional value. Overall, the deck focuses on aggressive plays and maximizing the cascading effect to gain a tempo advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells while utilizing the cascade mechanic to continually cast spells for free. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone, you can quickly build a board presence and disrupt your opponent's strategy. The mix of creatures like Shardless Agent and Murktide Regent provide additional threats, while cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety help protect your own game plan. The deck aims to be fast and disruptive, putting pressure on the opponent from the start of the game.

The deck focuses on aggressive and fast-paced gameplay, utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with threats on the board. The use of Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker helps to control the opponent's hand and graveyard. The deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain board presence through cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using powerful control elements such as Teferi, Time Raveler, Wrenn and Six, and Leyline Binding to disrupt the opponent's game plan while ramping into big threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also utilizes versatile removal spells like Prismatic Ending, Solitude, and Fury to deal with threats efficiently. The inclusion of Nissa, Resurgent Animist and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines provide additional value and win conditions. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage spells and hasty creatures, while also disrupting their life gain with cards like Skullcrack. The mana base includes fetch lands to ensure consistent access to red mana for the burn spells and features lands like Sunbaked Canyon and Fiery Islet for additional card draw. The key strategy is to apply consistent pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Orzhov Midrange deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while also being aggressive with creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Solitude. The deck also utilizes powerful removal spells like Undying Malice and Ephemerate to control the board. With a mix of creatures, spells, and equipment, this deck aims to outvalue the opponent through efficient creature removal, hand disruption, and well-timed plays. The inclusion of cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kaldra Compleat provide additional threats and win conditions for the deck.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creature cards to create powerful synergy and combo interactions. Using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can tutor for specific creatures to fit the situation. Cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide provide strong value and control options. The deck also includes utility creatures like Wall of Roots and Strangleroot Geist for added versatility. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble a board state that overwhelms the opponent and secures victory through strategic creature interactions.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Lotus Field and Underworld Breach to generate infinite card advantage and mana, enabling powerful combos to be consistently executed. The goal is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to either win the game outright or establish a dominant position on the board. The inclusion of various cheap spells and card selection tools helps to smooth out draws and find key pieces efficiently. Additionally, the deck incorporates some interaction in the form of Lightning Bolt, Unholy Heat, and Spell Pierce to disrupt opponent's plans and protect its own game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also includes creatures and enchantments that provide additional value and advantage, such as generating card advantage or offering powerful control effects. The key strategy is to maintain control of the board and slow down the opponent's advances while setting up win conditions or powerful late-game plays with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The One Ring.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through card advantage, disruption, and board control. It utilizes a mix of counterspells, removal, and planeswalkers to maintain control of the game while generating card advantage with Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also includes a few win conditions such as Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude. The companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, provides additional value and synergy with the deck's creature spells. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The key concept of this deck is to maximize the impact of Calibrated Blast, a combo card that allows you to exile your entire library and deal damage to your opponent. This is achieved by running cards like Gemstone Caverns, Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, and Throes of Chaos which help you manipulate your library and generate value. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Shelters All and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provides protection and additional support for your combo plan. Additionally, the deck includes a few lands with beneficial abilities, like Ramunap Ruins and Desert, to further enhance your strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling a wide range of creatures with unique abilities to create powerful combos. By using cards like Chord of Calling, Eldritch Evolution, and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, players can search for specific creatures in their toolbox to disrupt opponent's strategies and gain advantages. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Pendelhaven and Khalni Garden to provide additional support for the creatures. By carefully selecting and playing creatures like Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons and Grist, the Hunger Tide, players can overwhelm opponents and control the game to their advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade to bring out powerful creatures and disrupt opponent's strategies. Utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays while also controlling the board with counterspells like Mystical Dispute. The deck also includes versatile spells like Dead / Gone and Fire / Ice for added flexibility. By utilizing the Cascade mechanic effectively, the deck aims to put pressure on opponents early in the game and maintain control throughout the match.
